name: Canva Websites
category: Design tool with a website builder

pricing.free_plan: Free account publishes a one-page site to a canva.site address with a Canva badge

capabilities: Magic tools write copy and generate images
limits: Account was created without a phone number, but the website editor is canvas-based: applying a template and editing text could not be driven reliably in an automated run (checked 08.11.2026).
One page on the free plan
No database, so no booking or signup storage
summary: Lowest barrier of any builder here — a free account publishes a page in minutes, but it cannot store anything.
run_blocker: No website-from-prompt step: Magic Design generates social posts, the website builder starts from templates and the canvas editor cannot be driven automatically (checked 15.11.2026).

not_testable.reason: No AI prompt step for websites: Magic Design produces social posts, the website builder starts from templates and is edited by drag and drop. A run would measure the operator, not the tool.
